verdict.rationale: Square documents its own webhooks for real-time event notifications such as payments, refunds and inventory changes. It also offers a Webhook Subscriptions API for programmatic subscription, plus signature validation and webhook event logs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook delivery works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Learn about Square webhooks, which let developers receive real-time notifications of events, such as inventory changes and Point of Sale payments.
Learn about the Webhook Subscriptions API, which you can use to programmatically subscribe to webhooks.
verify that you receive the event notification and validate that the notification originated from Square.
Webhook event logs let you view the webhook event notifications sent by Square.
supports webhook events that notify you when a payment is created or updated.
